overview.en: This treeswift breeds from the Malay Peninsula through Sulawesi and the western Lesser Sunda Islands.
overview.fr: Cet hémiprocné niche de la péninsule Malaise jusqu’à Sulawesi et aux petites îles de la Sonde occidentales.

identification.en: Its long wing tips cross over the shorter forked tail when perched; males have rufous ear coverts.
identification.fr: Perché, ses longues pointes d’ailes se croisent au-dessus de sa queue fourchue plus courte ; le mâle a les couvertures auriculaires rousses.

habitat.en: In Indonesia it is recorded from seasonal and coastal forest as well as plantations, often using tall trees.
habitat.fr: En Indonésie, il est signalé dans les forêts saisonnières et côtières ainsi que les plantations, souvent près de grands arbres.

diet.en: It catches flying insects while foraging in the air.
diet.fr: Il capture des insectes en vol lorsqu’il se nourrit dans les airs.

behavior.en: It can perch conspicuously on tall branches and launch into circling flights to catch insects.
behavior.fr: Il se perche à découvert sur de hautes branches et s’élance en vol circulaire pour capturer des insectes.

reproduction.en: The small nest is fixed to a slender branch with hardened saliva, moss and feathers; the single egg is incubated by both adults.
reproduction.fr: Le petit nid est fixé à une branche fine avec de la salive durcie, de la mousse et des plumes ; les deux adultes couvent l’unique œuf.

ecology.en: The genus Hemiprocne also includes the Whiskered, Crested and Moustached treeswifts.
ecology.fr: Le genre Hemiprocne comprend aussi l’hémiprocné à moustaches, l’hémiprocné couronné et l’hémiprocné coiffé.

conservation.en: The Indonesian species account reports the global IUCN category Least Concern.
conservation.fr: La fiche indonésienne de l’espèce rapporte la catégorie mondiale UICN « préoccupation mineure ».

facts: Indonesian bilingual biodiversity summary gives breeding distribution, accepted taxonomy, vernacular names and global LC category.

title.en: Nesting of the Grey-rumped Treeswift — Bird Ecology Study Group
title.fr: Nidification de l’hémiprocné longipenne — Bird Ecology Study Group

facts: Singapore natural-history account documents crossed wing tips, sex differences, nest construction, single egg and shared incubation.

title.en: Birds of Baluran National Park — Hemiprocne longipennis
title.fr: Oiseaux du parc national de Baluran — Hemiprocne longipennis

facts: Indonesian field guide records seasonal and coastal forest, plantations, tall perches and aerial insect hunting.
French IOC-based family list distinguishes the four Hemiprocne species and names the Grey-rumped Treeswift.

uncertainties: Descriptions of breeding and habitat vary by local source; the nest details here are based on observations in Singapore.
review_note: Compared Indonesian distribution and field observations with Singapore nesting observations and current French/IOC family taxonomy.
